quest.title: Fire and Ice
quest.description: Go to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Arlecchino...

talks.objective: Head to a high vantage point in the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Thanks for the invitation, Sandrone. This food tastes just like I remember. It really brings back memories.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You're welcome. If you like, we can get together more often when I'm back in Snezhnaya. It'll be just like the old days.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Speaking of Snezhnaya, how's everything going on your end?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's plans have made some initial progress, but Project Stuzha is proving more difficult to implement than the Mayor anticipated.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Then it appears we'll both be busy from now on.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Though we should still have time to stop for a cup of tea every now and then, or even catch a performance by the Korolevskiy Troupe.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Indeed. Though we should still have time to stop for a cup of tea every now and then, or even catch a performance by the Korolevskiy Troupe.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Is Odette still performing ballet?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Yes. Every time I see her, she seems to keep getting better.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Amazing. I'd love to see her perform again when I'm back.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I find it really quite fascinating. Despite learning her craft under Rosalyne, their temperaments and styles couldn't be more different.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: That's not necessarily a bad thing.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: True... Rosalyne danced with a fiery passion, whereas Odette is as frosty and opaque as a block of solid ice.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: She appears to be carrying a heavy burden.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: And yet, when she performs on stage, her movements are so pure, as though her heart were free from even the tiniest of blemishes.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Or perhaps she's sealed such things away where no one will see them.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Perhaps. In the end, isn't that what ice does — freeze over the cracks? But she's not fragile, she's resolute. If anything, I'd say she's dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: At least in that regard, she resembles Rosalyne.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Because she's dangerous?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Because of her resolve.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I suppose you're right. No wonder there are rumors that she's the favorite to inherit the "La Signora" title.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah... Once we get to know her better, we could invite her to our tea parties. I hope she won't refuse.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Me too.

talks.objective: Head to a high vantage point in the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: It's important to find time to relax now and then.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Very well. I'll see you in Snezhnaya.
